## Summary

Following the review of #5263: express the shared-expert / DeepEP-dispatch overlap as a GraphTrainer
graph pass instead of an eager callback. That needs a prerequisite, which is most of this diff: the compact
DeepEP training path has to be traceable by GraphTrainer at all. Today `memory_policy.py` already lists
`deepep.dispatch`, but the ops have no fake kernels, the backward runs DeepEP directly, and the combine
relies on an eager-only stream wait.

## What changes

`torchtitan/distributed/deepep/deepep.py` (eager behavior preserved):
- every `deepep::` op gets a fake kernel; the received row count is an unbacked size (`new_dynamic_size()`),
  the same way the all-to-all path exposes data-dependent counts;
- the backward communications become ops (`dispatch_bwd`, `combine_bwd`) with fake kernels, so a traced joint
  graph contains them instead of running DeepEP on fake tensors;
- `combine` waits for its own communication (the dispatcher synchronized right after it anyway), which a
  traced graph needs because `sync_combine()` was never part of the graph;
- the handle cache is only touched inside op implementations; `setup_context` keeps the handle_id tensor;
- optional split of the compact dispatch into `launch_dispatch` + `wait_dispatch` (DeepEP v2.5
  `defer_epilogue`): `DeepEPTokenDispatcher.Config.split_dispatch_launch_wait`, default off. Eager runs them
  back to back; `_permute_tokens` uses `shape[0]` instead of `len()` so it traces with an unbacked size;
- `EPBuffer` / `ElasticBuffer` import compatibility (DeepEP v2.5 renamed the buffer); the DeepEP GPU test
  patches whichever class the installed DeepEP has.

`torchtitan/experiments/graph_trainer`:
- `compile.deepep_dispatch_overlap` and `deepep_overlap_pass`: for each forward `wait_dispatch`, every node in
  the window up to the combine's consumer that does not depend on the wait, has no side effect and is
  computable from pre-launch values (in the common MoE layout: the shared-expert FFN) is scheduled between
  the launch and the wait. Forward only, stable topological sort, no node added or changed. Independent of
  `ep_overlap`: DeepEP has one communication buffer, so the second in-flight exchange that chunking needs is
  not available, which is why this only sinks waits.
- memory policy lists the new ops as communication ops, `annotate_moe_ep_regions` covers the DeepEP
  dispatcher, test recipe `graph_trainer_deepseek_v3_debugmodel_deepep`, CPU unit tests for the pass, README.

## Validation (8 x H200 141GB, one node, torch 2.16.0.dev20261009+cu132, public DeepEP 2.5, NCCL 2.32.3)

- `tests/unit_tests/gpu/distributed/test_deepep_activation_checkpoint.py`: 2 passed (eager saved and
  replayed communication with the new backward ops).
- `experiments/graph_trainer/tests/test_deepep_overlap_pass.py`: 3 passed (CPU).
- `pre-commit run --files <changed>`: all hooks pass, no hook edits.
- GraphTrainer traces and trains the compact DeepEP path: `deepseek_v3_debugmodel` and the 16B flavor,
  EP8, FSDP8, default memory policy, 20-30 steps, synthetic packed inputs, deterministic mode.
- Pass ON vs OFF is bitwise identical: loss, grad_norm and final weights on all 8 ranks, 30 steps, in all
  four arms of an ABBA sequence; 26 MoE layers x 24 nodes moved (shared-expert mm/silu/mul/cat/split/...).
- DeepSeek-V3 16B (dim 2048, 64 experts top-6, 2 shared experts), EP8, 8192 tokens per rank,
  same-allocation ABBA, median over steps 6-30 of the per-step max-rank wall time:

  | arm | step ms |
  | --- | ---: |
  | OFF A1 | 1029.26 |
  | ON B1 | 1017.35 |
  | ON B2 | 1018.12 |
  | OFF A2 | 1030.13 |

  ON is 1.16% faster (both neighbour pairs -1.16% / -1.17%, arm repeats within 0.08%); peak memory
  unchanged (28.7 GiB). A profiler trace shows the shared-expert GEMMs inside the `wait_dispatch` host
  spans only with the pass; the GPU is already ~95% busy there from queue run-ahead, which bounds the gain.
  The debug model (256 tokens per rank) shows no measurable difference, consistent with #5263.
- For reference, the eager callback of #5263 on the same 16B / EP8 / 8192-token configuration (SelectiveAC,
  one OFF/ON pair, 30 steps) measures 910.5 -> 895.0 ms, -1.7%, bitwise identical; the two approaches hide the
  same window, so the gain is bounded the same way.

Not validated: multi-node, TP > 1 with EP, FP8 dispatch, CUDA graphs (the compact path has a host sync),
`ep_overlap` chunking composed with this pass, convergence on real data. Upstream GPU CI pins an older
DeepEP, so the v2.5-only split path is exercised only by the recipe above.

## Rebase validation (2026-10-19)

Rebased onto `main` at `48bbce4434df`. Followed the upstream MoE module move to
`torchtitan.models.common.moe.token_dispatcher`; the DeepEP debug recipe now explicitly
selects `attn_backend="flex"` in both builders, matching the upstream GraphTrainer recipes.

- Formatting, whitespace, Python AST, merge-conflict, license, flake8, ufmt, pydoclint,
  and codespell hooks passed across the full checkout.
- The three existing CPU scheduling tests passed on PyTorch `2.16.0.dev20261018`
  using source-defined DeepEP schemas and the real FX scheduling pass. This isolates
  graph reordering; no native DeepEP communication or CUDA code was exercised.
- Local Pyrefly diagnostics were identical to the same `main` checkout (no new
  diagnostics). A full type-check pass could not be established with the local
  dependency set.
- GPU training and communication tests were not rerun for this rebase. The 8-H200
  numerical and timing results above are from the original October 12 validation.

## Open questions

- Is the compact (data-dependent shape) DeepEP path acceptable in GraphTrainer graphs, or should GraphTrainer
  stay with HybridEP? The traceability part stands on its own even without the pass.
- Should the launch/wait split stay a dispatcher config, or be implied by GraphTrainer?
- Should the pass live in `ep_overlap_pass.py` as a single-chunk mode instead of its own module?

Supersedes the eager approach of #5263 if accepted.

+# Copyright (c) Meta Platforms, Inc. and affiliates.
+# All rights reserved.
+#
+# This source code is licensed under the BSD-style license found in the
+# LICENSE file in the root directory of this source tree.
+
+"""Schedule independent MoE work between a DeepEP dispatch launch and its wait.
+
+The DeepEP token dispatcher with ``split_dispatch_launch_wait`` gives the traced
+step a ``deepep.launch_dispatch`` node and a ``deepep.wait_dispatch`` node per MoE
+layer. The launch returns once the communication is queued; the wait blocks the
+host until the receive counts arrive and then materializes the received tokens.
+Eager code runs the two back to back, so the GPU idles during the host wait.
+
+This pass moves forward work that does not depend on the wait -- in the common
+MoE layout the shared experts, which eager code computes after the combine -- in
+front of the wait, directly after the launch. The GPU then runs that work while
+the dispatch is in flight. It is a scheduler only: no node is added, removed, or
+changed, and every data dependency is kept by a stable topological sort.
+
+Contract
+========
+For each forward ``wait_dispatch`` node W with launch node L:
+
+* the window is the graph order between L and the first consumer of the output
+  of the ``deepep.combine`` node fed by W (the end of the MoE layer);
+* filler is every window node that is not W, does not depend on W, has no side
+  effect (no mutating schema, no DeepEP op, no effect token), and whose inputs
+  are either before L or filler themselves, so it is computable before W;
+* filler never reads a tensor that a window node mutates;
+* the new order keeps L, then the filler, then W; all other nodes keep their
+  relative order.
+
+Backward is untouched: the dispatch backward is one ``dispatch_bwd`` op. The
+two-chunk ``ep_overlap`` pass is unrelated; DeepEP's single communication buffer
+cannot hold two in-flight dispatches, which is why this pass only sinks waits.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import logging
+import operator
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+import torch
+import torch.fx as fx
+from torch._dynamo.graph_deduplication import _stable_topological_sort
+from torch.utils._ordered_set import OrderedSet
+
+from torchtitan.experiments.graph_trainer.common_utils import _is_backward_node
+from torchtitan.experiments.graph_trainer.ep_pass_utils import ordered_nodes
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class DeepEPOverlapRecord:
+    """What the pass did for one dispatch wait, kept in ``gm.meta``."""
+
+    launch: str
+    wait: str
+    combine: str
+    num_filler: int
+    filler_targets: tuple[str, ...]
+
+
+def _deepep_op(name: str):
+    """Return the default overload of a ``deepep::`` op, or None when unregistered."""
+    try:
+        return getattr(torch.ops.deepep, name).default
+    except (AttributeError, RuntimeError):
+        return None
+
+
+def _call_target(node: fx.Node):
+    """Return the op a call node runs, looking through ``with_effects``."""
+    if node.op != "call_function":
+        return None
+    if node.target is torch.ops.higher_order.with_effects:
+        return node.args[1]
+    return node.target
+
+
+def _op_args(node: fx.Node) -> tuple:
+    """Return the op arguments of a call node, looking through ``with_effects``."""
+    if node.target is torch.ops.higher_order.with_effects:
+        return tuple(node.args[2:])
+    return tuple(node.args)
+
+
+def _value_producer(node: fx.Node) -> fx.Node:
+    """Return the call node behind a ``getitem`` of a multi-output op."""
+    if node.op == "call_function" and node.target is operator.getitem:
+        return node.args[0]
+    return node
+
+
+def _value_users(node: fx.Node) -> list[fx.Node]:
+    """Return the consumers of a node's values, looking through tuple unpacking."""
+    users: list[fx.Node] = []
+    for user in node.users:
+        if user.op == "call_function" and user.target is operator.getitem:
+            if node.target is torch.ops.higher_order.with_effects and user.args[1] == 0:
+                # The effect token is plumbing, not a value.
+                continue
+            users.extend(user.users)
+        else:
+            users.append(user)
+    return users
+
+
+def _descendants(node: fx.Node) -> set[fx.Node]:
+    result: set[fx.Node] = set()
+    stack = list(node.users)
+    while stack:
+        current = stack.pop()
+        if current in result:
+            continue
+        result.add(current)
+        stack.extend(current.users)
+    return result
+
+
+def _is_mutating(node: fx.Node) -> bool:
+    target = node.target
+    return isinstance(target, torch._ops.OpOverload) and target._schema.is_mutable
+
+
+def _is_pure_forward_call(node: fx.Node) -> bool:
+    """Whether a node may move: a forward call without side effects."""
+    if node.op != "call_function" or _is_backward_node(node):
+        return False
+    if node.target is torch.ops.higher_order.with_effects:
+        return False
+    target = node.target
+    if target is operator.getitem:
+        return True
+    if not isinstance(target, torch._ops.OpOverload):
+        return False
+    if target.namespace == "deepep" or target._schema.is_mutable:
+        return False
+    return True
+
+
+def _collect_filler(
+    window: list[fx.Node],
+    *,
+    launch: fx.Node,
+    wait: fx.Node,
+    wait_descendants: set[fx.Node],
+    order: dict[fx.Node, int],
+) -> list[fx.Node]:
+    mutated: set[fx.Node] = set()
+    for node in window:
+        if _is_mutating(node):
+            mutated.update(node.all_input_nodes)
+    filler: list[fx.Node] = []
+    filler_set: set[fx.Node] = set()
+    launch_order = order[launch]
+    for node in window:
+        if node is wait or node in wait_descendants:
+            continue
+        if not _is_pure_forward_call(node):
+            continue
+        inputs = node.all_input_nodes
+        if any(order[inp] > launch_order and inp not in filler_set for inp in inputs):
+            continue
+        if any(inp in mutated for inp in inputs):
+            continue
+        filler.append(node)
+        filler_set.add(node)
+    return filler
+
+
+def deepep_dispatch_overlap_pass(
+    gm: fx.GraphModule, example_inputs: tuple | None = None
+) -> fx.GraphModule:
+    """Move wait-independent MoE work between each DeepEP dispatch launch and wait."""
+    del example_inputs
+    launch_op = _deepep_op("launch_dispatch")
+    wait_op = _deepep_op("wait_dispatch")
+    combine_op = _deepep_op("combine")
+    if launch_op is None or wait_op is None or combine_op is None:
+        logger.info("deepep_dispatch_overlap: DeepEP ops are not registered, skipping")
+        return gm
+
+    order = ordered_nodes(gm)
+    nodes = list(gm.graph.nodes)
+    deps: dict[fx.Node, OrderedSet[fx.Node]] = {}
+    records: list[DeepEPOverlapRecord] = []
+    expected: list[tuple[fx.Node, list[fx.Node], fx.Node]] = []
+    for wait in nodes:
+        if _call_target(wait) is not wait_op or _is_backward_node(wait):
+            continue
+        launch = _value_producer(_op_args(wait)[3])
+        if _call_target(launch) is not launch_op:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"deepep_dispatch_overlap: {wait.name} does not consume a "
+                f"deepep.launch_dispatch result (got {launch.name})"
+            )
+        wait_descendants = _descendants(wait)
+        combines = [n for n in wait_descendants if _call_target(n) is combine_op]
+        if not combines:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"deepep_dispatch_overlap: no deepep.combine depends on {wait.name}"
+            )
+        combine = min(combines, key=order.__getitem__)
+        consumers = _value_users(combine)
+        if not consumers:
+            raise ValueError(f"deepep_dispatch_overlap: {combine.name} has no consumer")
+        stop = min(order[n] for n in consumers)
+        window = [n for n in nodes if order[launch] < order[n] < stop]
+        filler = _collect_filler(
+            window,
+            launch=launch,
+            wait=wait,
+            wait_descendants=wait_descendants,
+            order=order,
+        )
+        records.append(
+            DeepEPOverlapRecord(
+                launch=launch.name,
+                wait=wait.name,
+                combine=combine.name,
+                num_filler=len(filler),
+                filler_targets=tuple(sorted({str(n.target) for n in filler})),
+            )
+        )
+        if not filler:
+            continue
+        for node in filler:
+            deps.setdefault(node, OrderedSet()).add(launch)
+        deps.setdefault(wait, OrderedSet()).update(filler)
+        expected.append((launch, filler, wait))
+
+    gm.meta["deepep_dispatch_overlap"] = records
+    if not expected:
+        logger.info(
+            "deepep_dispatch_overlap: %d dispatch wait(s), nothing to move",
+            len(records),
+        )
+        return gm
+
+    _stable_topological_sort(gm.graph, deps)
+    gm.graph.lint()
+    gm.recompile()
+    new_order = ordered_nodes(gm)
+    for launch, filler, wait in expected:
+        first = min(new_order[n] for n in filler)
+        last = max(new_order[n] for n in filler)
+        if not new_order[launch] < first and last < new_order[wait]:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "deepep_dispatch_overlap failed to place filler between "
+                f"{launch.name} and {wait.name}"
+            )
+    logger.info(
+        "deepep_dispatch_overlap: moved %d node(s) before %d of %d dispatch wait(s)",
+        sum(len(filler) for _, filler, _ in expected),
+        len(expected),
+        len(records),
+    )
+    return gm

+def _build_moe_layer_graph(
+    *, mutate_input: bool = False
+) -> tuple[fx.GraphModule, dict]:
+    """A forward MoE layer in eager order: dispatch, routed experts, combine, shared."""
+    graph = fx.Graph()
+    x = graph.placeholder("x")
+    topk_idx = graph.placeholder("topk_idx")
+    topk_scores = graph.placeholder("topk_scores")
+    w_routed = graph.placeholder("w_routed")
+    w_shared = graph.placeholder("w_shared")
+    launch = graph.call_function(
+        torch.ops.deepep.launch_dispatch.default, (x, topk_idx, topk_scores, 8, 128)
+    )
+    wait = graph.call_function(
+        torch.ops.deepep.wait_dispatch.default, (x, topk_idx, topk_scores, launch, 2)
+    )
+    recv_x = graph.call_function(operator.getitem, (wait, 0))
+    handle_id = graph.call_function(operator.getitem, (wait, 4))
+    routed = graph.call_function(torch.ops.aten.mm.default, (recv_x, w_routed))
+    combine = graph.call_function(
+        torch.ops.deepep.combine.default, (routed, handle_id, True, 128)
+    )
+    mutation = None
+    if mutate_input:
+        mutation = graph.call_function(torch.ops.aten.add_.Scalar, (x, 1))
+    shared = graph.call_function(torch.ops.aten.mm.default, (x, w_shared))
+    out = graph.call_function(torch.ops.aten.add.Tensor, (combine, shared))
+    graph.output(out)
+    gm = fx.GraphModule(torch.nn.Module(), graph)
+    names = dict(
+        launch=launch,
+        wait=wait,
+        routed=routed,
+        combine=combine,
+        shared=shared,
+        out=out,
+        mutation=mutation,
+    )
+    return gm, names
+
+
+def test_shared_experts_move_between_launch_and_wait():
+    gm, n = _build_moe_layer_graph()
+    before = ordered_nodes(gm)
+    assert before[n["combine"]] < before[n["shared"]]
+
+    gm = deepep_dispatch_overlap_pass(gm)
+
+    after = ordered_nodes(gm)
+    assert after[n["launch"]] < after[n["shared"]] < after[n["wait"]]
+    assert after[n["wait"]] < after[n["routed"]] < after[n["combine"]] < after[n["out"]]
+    records = gm.meta["deepep_dispatch_overlap"]
+    assert len(records) == 1
+    assert records[0].num_filler == 1
+    assert records[0].filler_targets == ("aten.mm.default",)
+    assert len(list(gm.graph.nodes)) == len(before)
+
+
+def test_filler_does_not_cross_a_mutation_of_its_input():
+    gm, n = _build_moe_layer_graph(mutate_input=True)
+    before = ordered_nodes(gm)
+
+    gm = deepep_dispatch_overlap_pass(gm)
+
+    after = ordered_nodes(gm)
+    assert [after[node] for node in n.values()] == [before[node] for node in n.values()]
+    records = gm.meta["deepep_dispatch_overlap"]
+    assert records[0].num_filler == 0
+
+
+def test_backward_waits_are_ignored():
+    gm, n = _build_moe_layer_graph()
+    n["wait"].meta["autograd_backward"] = True
+    before = ordered_nodes(gm)
+
+    gm = deepep_dispatch_overlap_pass(gm)
+
+    assert ordered_nodes(gm) == before
+    assert gm.meta["deepep_dispatch_overlap"] == []
